title: Koffing's Agitation Can End in an Explosion

direction.premise: When agitated, Koffing raises gas toxicity, jets poison from its body, and may overinflate before exploding.
direction.audiencePromise: See Koffing escalate from toxic gas to body-wide jets and possible explosion.
direction.openLoop: What happens between agitation and that possible explosion?
direction.payoff: The danger is built into Koffing's body, from gas storage to possible explosion.
direction.engagementQuestion: Which scares you more: poison jets or a possible explosion?

voice.instructions: Speak like a knowledgeable fan sharing a startling discovery. Keep the pace quick, warm, and tense. Stress the escalation words, then pause briefly before the final choice.

scenes.headline: AGITATION CAN END IN EXPLOSION
scenes.narration: Koffing's agitation can raise toxicity, then end in explosion.
scenes.caption: AGITATION MAKES IT MORE DANGEROUS

scenes.headline: TOXIC GAS INSIDE
scenes.narration: Koffing stores several toxic gases, already making explosions possible.
scenes.caption: SEVERAL TOXIC GASES

scenes.headline: THE WHOLE BODY JETS POISON

scenes.headline: IT MAY OVERINFLATE
scenes.narration: Then Koffing can overinflate its round body before exploding.
scenes.caption: MAY OVERINFLATE, THEN EXPLODE

scenes.caption: STORAGE → JETS → MAY OVERINFLATE
